svg.title: Two Grays I
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Both panels have closely related light-grey paint; seam and tonal difference approximate the reference. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for gray; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-gray-1975-77-05-2001/lightbox/works/two-grays-i-1975-13147; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
